tool.name: Allele Frequency Calculator
tool.description: Compute genotype counts and per-SNP MAF
tool.command: python $__tool_directory__/allele_freq.py --genotypes $genotypes #if $snp_annot is not None --snp-annot $snp_annot #end if #if $sample_subset is not None --sample-subset $sample_subset #end if --missing-code $missing --out $out_file
tool.help:
**Description:** Counts genotypes (0,1,2) for each SNP and calculates MAF.
**Logic:** - If < 10 non-missing samples for a SNP, MAF = NA.
